status: Compact folded-belt engineering prototype with regenerated CAD inertias and collision proxies

assumptions.inertia: P5 native CAD mass and full tensors; supplier motor/reducer/brake envelope masses retained; explicit cable/fastener allowances and spring allocation. Both revised belt paths and relocated drive components included.
assumptions.gear_efficiency: Constant asymptotic efficiencies .70 (GP42C), .55 (GP22HP), inferred .6134 gripper; passive smooth low-speed factor exp(log(eta)*tanh(omega_motor/3 rad/s)*sign(current)). Transition speed is an uncalibrated engineering assumption; native dry friction remains separately modeled. P5 adds a stated 0.97 belt-stage efficiency screening assumption; actual belt losses, tension and tooth loading require measurement.
assumptions.contact_friction: Dry rubber/aluminum sliding coefficient .65 is an engineering assumption and must be measured for chosen pad finish/contamination.
assumptions.thermal: Single-node thermal capacity/resistance are provisional assumptions; temperatures are model estimates, not component certification.
assumptions.collision: External folded motor/reducer, output bearing/brake material, slotted carrier, windowed enclosure, revised counterbalance brackets, mounting foot and pedestal. Annuli use continuous overlapping conservative 24-sector boxes; no cavity-filling bearing or brake cylinders. Native BREP controls exact fitted interfaces. Flexible springs/belt contact, small fastener holes, internal shafts and vendor internals are outside proxy fidelity. No new body exclusions.
assumptions.rotating_inertia: Published motor rotor plus published gearhead input inertia, reflected by N squared into native joint armature. Gear spin is lumped; individual tooth/bearing/rotor bodies are not simulated. Added input pulley, input shaft, keys and translating-belt equivalent inertias identified by the P5 CAD record. The diagonal armature model does not resolve individual spinning-body gyroscopic coupling.

gripper.architecture: single opposed rack and pinion; q_left=q_right constraint; equal forces from common pinion torque
gripper.inference: R from12V/.75A extrapolatedstall; Kt=Ke inferred from330rpm no-load/.08A; eta inferred from1.3kgcm extrapolatedstall torque. Lumped Coulomb loss calibrated tono-loadcurrent. L andJ areassumed; notmanufacturerwindingmeasurements.

grasp_frame_note: Commanded puck centre224mm along tool axis; fixed physical pad/jaw origin219.2mm and nominal mechanical datum220mm. Gives1.5mm housing/puck clearance and21.2mm pad overlap at aligned pickup.
geometry_revision_note: P5 uses six folded 1:1 belt stages, full original motor/reducer envelopes, revised counterbalances, real two-bore bench fixture, CAD-derived moving tensors and corrected J3/J5 upper stops. Retained linkage geometry: Wrist/J5 centre extended16mm to elbow-to-wrist260mm, J4 cartridge remains atforeY204mm. NestA moved20mm outward toX290mm to preserve elbow tube/clamp clearance. Full-width6mm cradle rails; fork heelY-40..-34mm. Parent-body collision filtering disabled.

integration.status: Executable engineering prototype; supplier interfaces and physical safety qualification remain open

large.dynamic_torque_status: Engineering derating to 60% of M4; not a vendor-certified M1 value
large.delay_status: Conservative model delay/ramp; exact installation switching time must be measured
large.mount_status: Nominal PM size09 pattern; configured 0050 drawing and hub interface require vendor confirmation

small.family: Kendrion PM Line size 04 compact stator
small.dynamic_torque_status: Engineering derating to 60% of M4; not a vendor-certified M1 value
small.delay_status: Conservative model delay/ramp; exact installation switching time must be measured
small.mount_status: Compact 611 envelope, NOT the 62.5mm flange envelope of 62104-0018. Configured drawing and hub remain procurement gates

counterbalance.material: Proposed EN 10270-1 spring steel; grade, hook form, initial tension and fatigue life require spring supplier review
counterbalance.model: Two tension-only Hookean springs between the actual moving anchor coordinates; no ideal constant torque
counterbalance.installation: Compact pinned short-lever layout with actual BREP brackets; preload, spring fatigue and guarded installation still require qualification

gripper_driver.control: PH/EN; PWM with synchronized current sampling; independent hardware chopping ceiling; fault latches; VREF low by default

gripper_cable.note: Corrected: 4mm jacket + two 0.5mm liner walls requires 5mm hardware bore.

assumptions: Brake stator/armature split and interfaces are engineering envelopes, not vendor native CAD.
Brake torque/time/energy model is a screening model, not safety certification.
Cable routing is a nominal route with strain-relief geometry, not a flex-life qualification.
Spring winding/hook geometry and thermal motor constants require measured qualification.

elbow_counterbalance.material: Proposed spring steel; exact grade, initial tension, hook form and fatigue life require spring supplier qualification
elbow_counterbalance.model: Two tension-only springs at actual moving anchors. Reaction is represented by joint-3 generalized torque, not external support.
elbow_counterbalance.installation: Compact pinned short-lever layout with actual BREP brackets; preload, spring fatigue and guarded installation still require qualification

design_decisions: Retain finite 22Nm/2.2Nm static brake selection; dynamic braking remains an explicitly derated screening assumption.
Add a real 6Nm-reference elbow spring pair after doubled-delay fault tests showed approximately 10 degrees elbow travel without it.
Do not treat low catalog switching work as proof of acceptable stop distance.
Use nominal spring torque in control feedforward while plant strength varies; weak-spring testing no longer assumes perfect knowledge of deterioration.

P5 corrects inherited hard stops after exact native collision checks: J3 upper stop1.85rad, J5 upper stop1.63rad; soft maxima1.83/1.61rad. Coupled configurations still require collision-aware planning.

qualifications: Ring shape is installed envelope, not free-state supplier geometry.
Inner-race endplay must be measured and shim thickness selected; no unverified preload.
The specified root blend is not a claim of hob-generated trochoidal geometry.
D-flat nominal size is manufacturer-documented; tolerance, runout, clamping and inspection remain release gates.

folded_transmission.architecture: Parallel-axis folded motor/reducer with actual 1:1 toothed belt, bolted deck, slotted gearbox carriage and removable belt cover. Full original motor/reducer envelope sizes preserved.
folded_transmission.tooth_geometry_status: Nominal rounded tooth/groove screening geometry with explicit clearance, not a manufacturing-certified HTD cutter profile. Supplier belt tension and torque rating required.

rating_screen.qualification: Catalog screening at lowest tabulated speed; low-speed extrapolation, custom tooth shape, pretension, alignment, fatigue and supplier approval remain unqualified.

bench_interface.mount_fasteners: Six nominal M8 through-bolts, retaining nuts and individual Ø28 mm steel backing washers; bench strength not qualified.

tabletop_fixture.collision_approximation: At most 1 mm wide strips; aperture lies within each native circular opening, conservatively retaining bench material.

belt_rating_screen.implementation: Torque demand limited by both gearhead and corrected belt capacity/service factor. Actual electromechanical torque is checked independently; no artificial output-position locking.
belt_rating_screen.limitations: No compliant tooth or belt-slip simulation. Rating application, belt tension, supplier geometry, shafts and fatigue remain physical qualification items. Direct-output brakes do not transmit their holding torque through this belt stage.
